title: Role Management

hint.template: Only the permissions are copied. The two roles are independent afterward.
hint.newRoleUnsaved: The new role won't affect any users until it's saved.
hint.deleteRule: System default roles can't be deleted. To delete a role that users still have, change those users' roles first.
hint.autoGrantAccess: "View" was selected automatically: Add, Edit, and Delete all require View.
hint.autoRevokeDependent: Add, Edit, and Delete were also cleared: they can't be used without View.
hint.menuDisabled: The menu is temporarily turned off. The permissions here are kept as they are and take effect as soon as the menu is re-enabled.

meta.saveImpact: · Saving will immediately change this user's permissions | · Saving will immediately change the permissions of these {n} users

reverted: Reverted to the settings as loaded.
